Agent(s) Subject to Criteria:
Rhofade AE, CC, QL
oxymetazoline cream AE, CC, QL
Criteria for Approval:
• Diagnosis of rosacea or facial erythema; AND
• Trial and failure of topical metronidazole; AND
• Trial and failure of an oral antibiotic (e.g., doxycycline).

Age Limit: ≥ 18 years
Quantity Limit: 60 grams per 30 days
